Overview

Weather Girl (Thief) is a MythicalMythical Limited unit. She is only obtainable by evolving Weather Girl.

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Passive: Treasure Thief

Upon placement, Weather Girl (Thief) will mark an enemy (one per placement, so up to 3 per round) with a Beli symbol. Upon killing the enemy in question mark, the player will receive additional gold. Bonus gold amount increases with levels.

Trivia

  • With 1,000¥, she is one of the five cheapest MythicalMythical upon deployment alongside Idol (Star), Hubris (Night), Captain (God) and Boxer, Griffin (Ascension) , and she dethroned Lex Akoman from being the cheapest to max, with 22,750¥.
